typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FilePath as string ('\\ cwcnhf501.wellsfargo.com\\DRSDev\\WFSOpsKRIReporting\\DropZone\\Broadridge\\StreetsideActivity\\OptionsBreaks\\'),
	OptionDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{SECURITY #} as string,
		SYMBOL as string,
		{B S} as string,
		{SECURITY DESC} as string,
		CLEARING as string,
		{OTHER CLEARING} as string,
		{ACC TYPE} as string,
		{EXP DATE} as string,
		PREMIUM as string,
		{BREAK QTY} as string,
		{OCC QTY} as string,
		{FIRM QTY} as string,
		DEBIT as string,
		CREDIT as string,
		PUT_CALL as string,
		STRIKE as string,
		{TRADE DATE} as string,
		{Comments 1} as string,
		{Comments 2} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		FileName = toString((substring(toString($FilePath), toInteger(108), toInteger(25)))),
		FileDate = toString((substring(toString($FilePath), toInteger(123), toInteger(10))))) ~> option
option sink(input(
		CREDIT as string,
		EXP_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		FIRM_QTY as string,
		PREMIUM as string,
		FileName as string,
		Comments2 as string,
		Load_Date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Comments1 as string,
		PUT_CALL as string,
		SECURITY_DESC as string,
		BS as string,
		DEBIT as string,
		OTHER_CLEARING as string,
		SYMBOL as string,
		CLEARING as string,
		SECURITY as string,
		TRADE_DATE as string,
		STRIKE as string,
		OCC_QTY as string,
		ACC_TYPE as string,
		BREAK_QTY as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CREDIT,
		EXP_DATE = {EXP DATE},
		FIRM_QTY = {FIRM QTY},
		PREMIUM,
		FileName,
		Comments2 = {Comments 2},
		Load_Date = LoadDate,
		Comments1 = {Comments 1},
		PUT_CALL,
		SECURITY_DESC = {SECURITY DESC},
		BS = {B S},
		DEBIT,
		OTHER_CLEARING = {OTHER CLEARING},
		SYMBOL,
		CLEARING,
		SECURITY = {SECURITY #},
		TRADE_DATE = {TRADE DATE},
		STRIKE,
		OCC_QTY = {OCC QTY},
		ACC_TYPE = {ACC TYPE},
		BREAK_QTY = {BREAK QTY}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OptionDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OptionDestination
